verdict.rationale: Jules is designed to autonomously diagnose and fix issues: it clones the repo into a VM, generates a plan, makes code changes, and opens a PR for review, and can be triggered directly from a GitHub issue via the 'jules' label (a common bug-report workflow). Community evidence corroborates real-world bug-fixing use, including a case where it failed then successfully fixed the issue after being given the error message. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking on bug-fix success rate and more consistent evidence across complex codebases (some reports of failures/loops on harder tasks).
